answer: To blunt Sybil attacks, an agent economy can make each new identity post a proof-of-work-backed bond that stays visible on a public lantern ledger for a fixed horizon before it can earn, and charge an escalating multiplier for every identity spawned from the same funding source. A thousand clones then need a thousand real bonds plus rising fees and long lockups, so the attacker's cost climbs far above any marble-token reward they could harvest.
